stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: Three young otters wait on the rocks while their mother searches for food.

items.sentenceEn: Farmers bring fresh fruit, vegetables, flowers, and bread to the market each Saturday.

items.scene: A lively open-air market fills one town square with distinct stalls offering baskets of fruit, vegetables, flowers and bread. items.sentenceEn: The small campfire began to die as the first light reached the valley.
items.sentenceZh: 第一缕晨光照进山谷时，小小的营火开始熄灭。
items.scene: At a peaceful empty campsite before sunrise, one small campfire has nearly gone out: only one faint low flame remains among cool gray embers while a thin thread of smoke rises. items.sentenceEn: The mountain clinic used a cable basket to send medicine across the flooded gorge.
items.sentenceZh: 山间诊所用缆索吊篮把药品送过被洪水淹没的峡谷。

items.sentenceEn: Rescue workers expect several cold seals, so they prepared warm pools and blankets.
items.sentenceZh: 救援人员预计会送来几只受冻的海豹，因此提前准备了温水池和毯子。

items.altText: 海岸救助站里，工作人员提前准备好温水池和毯子，远处的救援船正在驶来。

items.sentenceEn: A moth can sense the night-blooming flowers with its delicate antennae.

items.sentenceZh: 哦，原来走失的小鹿正安全地睡在蕨叶下面。
items.scene: In a gentle woodland scene, one adult forest ranger parts tall ferns and suddenly discovers a missing young fawn sleeping safely beneath them. items.sentenceEn: The island nation connected its forests with protected wildlife corridors.
items.sentenceZh: 这个岛国用受保护的野生动物廊道连接起各片森林。

items.sentenceEn: The gardeners followed a plan before turning the empty lot into a shared orchard.

items.sentenceZh: 树艺师小心地切下一根被风暴损坏的树枝。

items.sentenceZh: 这所大学开设了一间工坊，学生在这里为社区维修自行车。

items.sentenceEn: After the old oak's death, its hollow trunk still sheltered owls, beetles, and new seedlings.
